Dialogs.Dialog: (Okay, that's library duty done for today... Huh？ Where'd ▲小早川＊▲ go？)
(A text from ▲小早川＊▲...)
Waiting on the roof. Rinko
(The roof... Don't tell me, not again...)
Huff, huff... ▲小早川＊▲!!
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲.
▲小早川＊▲... So you were here. Phew...
Out of breath again, making that face...
Well, yeah.
It's okay... Rinko's not crying, see？
Yeah, okay...
I just wanted to watch the sunset with you. It was pretty.
Not just when I want to cry. I want you with me when I'm happy, too.
Yeah... You're right.
See, there's that face again.
What face？
Your usual face. Acting all older... Weirdo.
Don't call me a weirdo...
Hehe... Hey, remember the first time we met？
I remember... It was a warm, sunny day.
Yeah... I used to hate spring.
New people, new classes... It was like a whole world that had nothing to do with me.
It made it even clearer that Rinko was all alone.
But from now on, every time spring comes, I'll remember that day.
Yeah... I'm glad.
It was a hot day. The shade under that tree felt nice.
That spot was where I'd go to read whenever something bothered me.
Reading where no one could bother me, I could be in a world that was just mine.
I see... Guess I got in the way, huh？
You sure did. ...Since then, Rinko's world hasn't been a lonely one.
Right, it was Reading Week that fall.
Yeah. The library was packed, so I grabbed some book and read it outside.
And it turned out to be a romance story. The kind I hated.
So when you talked to me, I was mean. It was like some cheesy drama...
I see. Bad timing, huh.
Yeah, it was a cold day...
Yeah. Sorry... for being mean.
'The big winter shelf reorganization,' right？
Because... back then, I was fine being alone.
I didn't have anyone on my side back then, like I do now...
Hey, you were staring at me back then, weren't you？
Um... Was I？
You were. Rinko was looking at you too, you know？
Because... you were nothing like the person I always imagined. The one person in the world who'd love me.
Nothing like？
Nope.
Not even a little？
Not at all.
So... was that guy handsome？
Who knows... I can't really remember.
Whenever I try, I end up picturing this face.
...My face？
Yeah. ...Gentle, a little troubled. The face Rinko loves most in the world.
Hey... This is how much Rinko loves you. So much I could go crazy...
Until now, I thought it was okay if you saw me as a little sister, but... that's not enough anymore.
Not like that. I want you to love me more, and...
I want you to be... Rinko's boyfriend.
I love you, too
I'm sorry
I love you too, ▲小早川＊▲... I want you to be my girlfriend.
Okay. I'll be your girlfriend... Thank you.
Hehe... This is a little embarrassing, huh？
Yeah, kind of...
Ah, you're making that troubled face again.
Huh, am I？
You are. You still think of Rinko as a little sister.
That's not true.
Really？
Really.
Then come here...
...Is it okay if I kiss you？
...Yeah. I'm your girlfriend, after all...
It really was... nothing like I imagined.
Oh... Sorry, I guess.
That's not what I mean. My heart pounded way more than I imagined... I'm all full.
Full？
Yeah. Full of 'I love you'...
I love you so much.
Sorry... I just can't see you that way...
To me, ▲小早川＊▲ is like a little sister.
...Sorry.
No... Honestly, I kind of knew.
There's that... troubled face again.
I'm okay. See？ Rinko's not crying.
Yeah... You're right.
Hey, one question.
Even as your little sister, you'll always be on Rinko's side, right？
Yeah. Even if it's Rinko and me against the world.
...Then, a promise seal.
Hehe... I'm gonna keep making you worry, you know？
(Okay, that's library duty done for today... Huh？ Where'd ▲小早川＊▲ go？)
(A text from ▲小早川＊▲...)
What are you doing？ I'm on the roof. Rinko
(What am I doing？ What about you... The roof... Don't tell me, again...)
Huff, huff... ▲小早川＊▲!!
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲.
▲小早川＊▲... So you were here. Phew...
You're late. What if Rinko had been crying？
...Were you crying？
No... I promised I wouldn't cry alone, remember？
Right. You did.
See, there's that worried big brother face again.
Am I making that face？
You are. Even though I keep saying I'm not your little sister.
I know.
I hope so...
Remember the first time we met？
I remember... It was a warm, sunny day.
Rinko... used to hate spring.
New people, new classes... It was like a whole world that had nothing to do with me.
I knew it was my own fault, but it felt like I was the only one left out...
That's why I was a little mean. Sorry, okay？
It's fine. Really.
It was a hot day. The shade under that tree felt nice.
Right？ That was Rinko's special spot.
Reading where no one could bother me, I could be in a world that was just mine.
I see... Guess I got in the way, huh？
You did. ...Since then, Rinko's world hasn't been a lonely one.
Right, it was Reading Week that fall.
So the library was packed, and I grabbed some book and went outside...
And it was a romance story, the kind Rinko hates.
Then you came and talked to me... It was like some cheesy drama...
So that's why you were in a bad mood？
Sorry...
Yeah, it was a cold day...
Yeah.
'The big winter shelf reorganization,' right？
You do remember... Are you still mad？
I'm not mad.
Hehe... Good.
Hey, you were staring at me back then, weren't you？
...Did I？
You were. What were you thinking？
Just... that you were cute.
Oh... Sorry.
For what？
Rinko thought you were kind of a weirdo. Just a little.
O-Oh...
Because... you were acting all grown-up, and you were nothing like him.
Nothing like who？
The person Rinko sometimes imagined. Someone who'd find me someday.
The one person in the world who'd love Rinko.
But it's weird, you know？ Whenever I try to picture that person now...
I see this face.
This face...
Yeah... The face that always worries about Rinko. The face Rinko loves most in the world.
Rinko must be really dense... I never noticed.
Not until you said you'd be on my side.
I love you... ever since then. So much I could cry.
So I don't want you to see me as a little sister. I hate that.
Not like that. I want you to really love me.
Rinko... wants to be your girlfriend.
I love you, too
I'm sorry
I love you too, ▲小早川＊▲... I want you to be my girlfriend.
...Really？
No 'like a little sister' stuff, okay？
I know.
Then... how much？
How much？ ...A whole lot.
That doesn't tell me anything...
Then, um... What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？
Rinko loves you... ten times that.
That doesn't tell me anything either.
Sure it does. ...Come here.
So, was it ten times？
My heart was pounding too hard to tell...
Rinko too... My chest got all tight, and I couldn't tell...
Then one more time...
No way. As of today, these are Rinko's lips. No using them without asking.
Aw, come on...
Hehe... I was mean again.
One more time is okay... Go on？
Sorry... I just can't see you that way...
To me, ▲小早川＊▲ is like a little sister.
...Sorry.
I know... Rinko knew that much.
But I just couldn't hold it in...
Sorry, but I...
It's okay to cry when it's just the two of us, right？
I'm not crying. Hehe...
So you'll always be on my side, right？
Of course... Even if it's ▲小早川＊▲ and me against the world.
...Yeah.
(Okay, that's library duty done for today... Huh？ Where'd ▲小早川＊▲ go？)
(A text from ▲小早川＊▲...)
The sunset's really pretty. Rinko
(Sunset？ Is she on the roof...？ Don't tell me...)
Huff, huff... ▲小早川＊▲!!
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲.

Sorry, I made you worry again...
Well, yeah.
It's okay... Rinko's not crying, see？
Yeah, good.
I just wanted to watch the sunset with you. It's really pretty, see？
Yeah... It really is.
It's okay to be together when I'm happy too, right？ Not just when I want to cry.
Of course. Let's do that.
There's that worried big brother face again.
Am I making it？
You are. A little troubled... and really gentle.
That's kind of embarrassing...
Hehe... Hey, remember the first time we met？
I remember... It was a warm, sunny day.
Yeah... But you know, Rinko used to hate spring.
New people, new classes... It was like a whole world that had nothing to do with me.
It made me feel even more alone than usual. It made me sad.
But I'll be okay from now on. When I think of that day, Rinko...
It was a hot day. The shade under that tree felt nice.
That spot was where I'd go to read whenever I felt sad.
Reading where no one was around let me get away from sad things.
I see... Guess I got in the way, huh？
No... I think since then, little by little, Rinko...
Right, it was Reading Week that fall.
Yeah. The library was packed... It's funny, you know？
The book I borrowed that day was a romance story, the kind Rinko hates, but...
Somehow I got really into it...
So when you talked to me, it startled me.
It was like the story kept going, and I got embarrassed.
I never thought I'd feel like this...
It was a cold day... 'The big winter shelf reorganization,' right？
Sorry... Rinko was really mean, wasn't she？
It's fine now.
Back then, Rinko liked being alone.
I never thought... I'd feel like I do now...
Hey, you were staring at me back then, weren't you？
Um... Was I？
You were. ...I know, because I was looking at you too.
Oh, so that's how it was...
We'd only just met, but it felt familiar somehow. Even though you were nothing like...
Nothing like who？
The person Rinko always imagined. The one person in the world who'd love me.
That person is super handsome, you know？
See, that face. Rinko was mean just now, wasn't she？
You made that same face back then.
I think, deep down, Rinko was always looking for it.
Someone who'd look at me like that.
I can't really tell myself...
It's... a little troubled, and gentle...
The face Rinko loves most in the world. Looking at it makes me want to cry...
Not long ago, I thought it was fine if you saw me as a little sister...
But now... that's not enough anymore.
I want you to love Rinko more and more.
Not as a little sister. I want you to make me your girlfriend.
I love you... I love you so much.
I love you, too
I'm sorry
I love you too, ▲小早川＊▲... I want you to be my girlfriend.
Say it again... Say 'I love you.'
Okay... I love you, ▲小早川＊▲.
Hehe...
▲名前▲, Rinko loves you too... so much.
Love's a strange thing. Every time I say it, my chest gets all tight.
It's true...
Can I try something？ Something I've always wanted to know.
Yeah, sure.
Hehe... I knew it.
My chest got all tight... even more than with 'I love you.'
So a kiss is what you do when 'I love you' isn't enough.
Yeah, seems that way.
We should've done this sooner.
We can do it anytime now.
Not anytime. Only when the 'I love you' fills up.
I see...
See, the troubled face again... Oh.
I think it just filled up...
Sorry... I just can't see you that way...
To me, ▲小早川＊▲ is like a little sister.
...Sorry.
See... the troubled face again.
...Yeah.
Right... This is how it should be.
Rinko likes that big brother face of yours anyway.
One question.
Will you always be on Rinko's side？
Of course, always. Even if it's Rinko and me against the world.
Thanks... Hehe. Then I'll live with it... In exchange...
Take care of me from now on, big brother▼

▲主人公＊▲.

Sure, go ahead
Keep it like it is
Then...
▲主人公＊▲. I'm counting on you from now on...

Make up your mind... Fine, I'm calling you by your name.

Keep it like it is

So wishy-washy. I'm calling you by your name, okay？

Sure, go ahead
Keep it like it is

Aw... Okay. I'll keep it like this for now.
Can't decide？ Then I'm using your name. Done deal.

Okay, sounds good
